name: revopush
description: Official Revopush skills for integrating and managing over-the-air (OTA) updates in React Native and Expo apps.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate Revopush OTA updates into React Native and Expo apps
interface.longDescription: Official Revopush-authored skills for adding over-the-air (OTA) updates to React Native and Expo apps with the @revopush/react-native-code-push SDK. Detects bare RN vs Expo and the native variants (Swift/Objective-C, Kotlin DSL/Groovy, Kotlin/Java), wires iOS and Android, applies the codePush() HOC or the advanced manual sync() API, selects the correct 2.x SDK version, and covers deployment keys and the Revopush CLI for releasing.
defaultPrompt: Add over-the-air updates to my React Native app with Revopush
Set up revopush in my Expo router app
Wire a 'Check for updates' button using the Revopush manual API
Migrate my app from Microsoft CodePush to Revopush
